configuration.change: Match blue-population grain with measured Gaia stars and one resolved-light fraction.

details.grain: The existing native Gaia young-member points retain their positions, adopted 150 pc heights and individual RP/G/BP flux colors. Only their share of the conserved young luminosity changes.
details.selection: Gaia Collaboration, Luri et al. 2021 Young 1 and Young 2; same accepted member bank as l21 and l29.
details.frozen: All densities, point coordinates and colors, dust, object amplitudes, and the l32 component and global grades.
